title: GAAC: Lossless KV Compression for Bandwidth-Efficient LLM Inference on Personal Devices
abstract: arXiv:2610.38210v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight-only, lossy quantization substantially reduces the storage and memory requirements for serving large language models (LLMs), but the growing key-value (KV) cache remains a bottleneck for long-context inference on personal devices. We present Group-Adaptive Additive Codec (GAAC), a lossless KV compression and serving system that exploits exponent redundancy to reduce storage and accelerate attention without introducing KV approximation. GAAC encodes BF16 exponents using calibrated per-channel base-plus-offset codes over contiguous ranges. GAAC adapts code widths across small groups while preserving KV values bit-for-bit. A fused attention kernel reconstructs KV tiles on the fly, avoiding full-cache decompression. Block-wise compression and fixed-capacity slots support incremental cache updates and paged serving. Across five tested models, GAAC achieves 1.405-1.407$\times$ lossless BF16 KV compression. We also study compression perf

translated_title: GAAC：面向个人设备带宽高效大语言模型推理的无损KV压缩
translated_abstract: 仅针对权重的有损量化大幅降低了服务大语言模型（LLM）所需的存储和内存开销，但不断增长的关键值（KV）缓存仍然是个人设备上进行长上下文推理的瓶颈。我们提出了组自适应加性编解码器，这是一种无损的KV压缩与服务系统，它利用指数冗余来减少存储占用并加速注意力计算，且不引入任何KV近似。GAAC使用在连续范围内校准的逐通道“基址加偏移”编码来编码BF16指数，并在小组之间自适应调整码宽，同时逐位保留KV数值。融合的注意力内核可以即时重建KV分块，避免了整个缓存的解压缩。分块压缩和固定容量槽位设计支持增量式缓存更新与分页服务。在五个测试模型上，GAAC实现了1.405-1.407倍的无损BF16 KV压缩。我们还研究了压缩性能……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: GAAC利用BF16指数的冗余性实现无损KV缓存压缩（约1.4倍），并通过融合注意力内核即时重建KV数据，在不损失任何精度的情况下加速个人设备上的长上下文LLM推理。
en_tdlr: GAAC exploits BF16 exponent redundancy to achieve ~1.4x lossless KV cache compression with a fused attention kernel that reconstructs KV tiles on the fly, accelerating long-context LLM inference on personal devices without any accuracy loss.
